status: production Lean endpoint cache timing sample
scope: The original and cached production permutations are evaluated in both directions. The input is a stored list with four repeated values; birth word and target word are equal. The recorded times are one local sample in Lean's executable evaluator, not a runtime complexity proof.
correctness: Word.cachedOptimal_eq proves equality of the full permutations. The benchmark also checks both-direction checksums against n*(n-1). A local IO reference forces each result before its ending clock read.
implementation: The cached builder stores both word vectors, then builds one explicit dependent map table per distinct birth value. Generated C constructs the arrays and map table before creating lookup closures.
reproduce: lake build Shuffler.Optimality.BirthPlacement.Word.Cached && lake env lean --run Bench/BirthEndpointCache.lean
